channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: College sweethearts Amy and Aron never imagined they would be empty nesters in their 40's, but here they are with two children about to move out and their dreams of retiring by the ocean closer than ever; they have decided to live that dream now and are on the hunt for a home by the water with enough land to have a few goats.
